description: The 5-row template as a template page opens it: every image-set item unranked (two in a subfolder, one labelled with its filename), no title.
7-row Overwatch ranking with an empty D tier and a title with curly quotes, an apostrophe, emoji, CJK, Hangul and a backslash.

Rows dragged into a new order (tier ids no longer match their positions) and renamed: emoji, double quotes, an empty label, Arabic, HTML-like text. THE FINALS items whose label changed case since 2024.
A 3-row list with no items and an empty title (the encoders leave an empty title out).
Uploaded (custom) items next to package items: labels with parentheses, accents, ZWJ emoji, quotes, a backslash, a flag, and an empty label (a file named ".png").
Every item of all seven packages at bf2ff6e (430 items) spread over the 7-row template.

A list switched to the 3-row template, with items from SUPERVIVE, Web Development, HELLDIVERS 2 and WUTHERING WAVES (nested filenames, labels with quotes and a leading dot), and a title that looks like HTML.
Three rows with labels that keep spaces, a line break and a tab, all 130 HELLDIVERS 2 items left in the unranked row, and a title made of spaces (kept, because it is not empty).
